signatures.description: Implement a causally ordered broadcast layer over an unreliable transport: every node keeps a vector clock and a holdback queue and may deliver a message only once all of its causal predecessors have been delivered, while a node that stalls for K messages must not cause unbounded memory growth or deadlock. Given a captured trace of send/receive events with duplicates, reordering, late arrivals, two node joins and one node leave, produce the exact per-node delivery order plus a gap report naming the unreachable predecessors. The layer must be deterministic across runs and must classify a predecessor as permanently lost within a bounded number of live messages so the holdback queue can be compacted.
